offering_description.value: Contract development and manufacturer (CDMO) of medical devices and components for large medical device makers. Produces components and finished devices for cardiac rhythm management, neuromodulation, vascular, structural heart, orthopedic and surgical uses. Also makes batteries and power sources for implantable and portable medical devices.

primary_products.value: cardiac and neuromodulation device components; vascular catheters and delivery systems; implantable batteries; orthopedic instruments and implants; finished medical devices

primary_services.value: medical device design and development; contract manufacturing; precision machining and assembly; sterile packaging and testing

customer_segment.value: B2B: Medical device OEMs such as large cardiac, neuromodulation, vascular and orthopedic device companies

end_markets.value: medical devices; cardiac rhythm management; neuromodulation; vascular; orthopedics; surgical

revenue_model.value: product sales: components and finished devices made to customer specifications; project or contract: design, development and engineering programs for customers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: contract manufacturer making devices and components from purchased metals and materials for medical device OEMs; component supplier: supplies batteries, leads, catheters and precision components to device brand owners

geography_served.value: global: Manufacturing in the US, Mexico, Costa Rica, Ireland and Malaysia, customers worldwide

specialization.value: related lines: cardio and vascular, neuromodulation, power, orthopedics and surgical contract manufacturing for medical device customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct supply to medical device OEM customers under long-term agreements

regulatory_exposure.value: high: medical device manufacturing under FDA quality system rules, ISO 13485 and international medical device regulators
